fact: The EACO regional report for 2024-2025 says Burundi's One Network Area inbound traffic rose 126%, from 89.6 million to 202.9 million minutes, and outbound traffic rose 82.4%, from 12.1 million to 22.1 million minutes, after it joined the ONA roaming framework.
title: EACO Regional Statistics Report 2026: Regional Communications Sector Performance and Insights
